limitations: Engineering evidence only; no S24/S26 execution or release certification.
Single host observations do not establish variance or isolate each repair contribution.
BenchExec peak_rss_bytes authority is cgroup memory including charged page cache, not process VmHWM.
Historical logical I/O instrumentation differs, including recovery attribution.
Named owner and component inventories overlap; do not sum them with the retained physical union.
Final owner inventories do not decompose an earlier temporal peak.
Timing rows measure disjoint public calls, exclude outside decode/checkpoint/open work, and are not CPU or whole-ingest time.

owned_build_reclamation.scope: Only isolated task-owned regenerable dev cache and explicitly named unmeasured debug validation/diagnostic copies. Preserve all source worktrees, measured release binaries, raw logs and evidence.
owned_build_reclamation.accounting: Actual filesystem available-byte delta; not the sum of overlapping file owners. Concurrent unrelated filesystem activity can affect this observation.

capacity_followup_accounting.note: Projected demand reduction and observed filesystem reclamation are separate. Available capacity varies with other filesystem activity. No S24/S25/S26 execution.
